claims.quote: financial statement, for example bank, building society, credit card or credit union statement
claims.note: A bank statement is listed only as one optional supplementary ID document for in-person identity checks, not as required evidence for the claim.

claims.claim: The bank statements must cover the last 3 months.
claims.note: No GOV.UK source mentions a 3-month period of bank statements; only the Northern Ireland page, which is another nation's version, mentions a three-month statement.

claims.quote: electoral register confirmation that you live at the address
claims.note: Documents confirming your address appear only as optional supplementary ID documents for in-person identity checks; the GOV.UK sources do not require proof of address.
